kpis.name: Digital penetration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of digital sales relative to total sales
kpis.description: Digital penetration is a key indicator of online and omnichannel commerce adoption

kpis.name: Average headcount
kpis.explanation: Average number of employees during the fiscal year
kpis.description: Average annual headcount of 84,000 employees includes approximately 29,000 full-time and 55,000 part-time workers

kpis.name: Net sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from merchandise sales, net of expected returns
kpis.description: Net sales down 4% to $14.8 billion, primarily driven by a 4% decrease in transaction volume

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 34 basis points driven by better inventory management and reduced markdowns

kpis.name: Store count
kpis.explanation: Total number of Kohl's stores operated

risks.title: Economic risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to general economic conditions, consumer spending levels, and other external conditions, which could decline. (Item 1A, p. 7)

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The retail sector is highly competitive, and the company faces competition from online retailers, discount retailers, warehouse clubs, and others. (Item 1A, p. 5)

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events, such as hostilities, pandemics, or public health crises, could adversely impact the company's operations. (Item 1A, p. 7)

risks.title: Supply chain dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its suppliers to obtain merchandise, and any issues with these suppliers could adversely impact operations. (Item 1A, p. 5)

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, such as cyberattacks or data breaches. (Item 1C, p. 17)

risks.title: Reputational risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputational risks, such as negative criticism on social media or in the media. (Item 1A, p. 7)

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in Kohl's 10-K filing for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026.
